name: Custom Tempo Range
author: JC
summary: Maps +/-6/10/16 TEMPO slots to +/-4/8/16; WIDE stays +/-100%. Shows deck BPM with 2 decimals (125.00).
description: TEMPO RANGE slots +/-6/10/16 become +/-4/8/16 (each selectable, std = stock) on all four decks; WIDE stays +/-100%. Draws the deck BPM to two decimals (125.00) and the chosen +/-NN label; in the 2-deck view both follow the layer (1/3, 2/4). Firmware 2.00/2.01 (ep147-9e9454e357389ece) only: hooks TempoCtl::recompute and re-feeds ST_SET_TEMPO so playback and Link follow. Conflicts with the bpm2dp mod (both draw over the BPM digits): turn bpm2dp off.
